title: Book Two · Chapter 138: The Cooler Term
story:
The summer holiday ends. The new term begins in cooler weather. Ronan is still twelve, but his sleeves end higher on his arms. Mum opens a small fold in each sleeve. He can wear the shirt a little longer.

“At this rate, I need a ladder to measure you,” she says.

Ronan stands very straight. “I can bend.”

“Then I will measure the wrong boy.”

At school, the reading room has a new shelf and the same two doors. The materials room notice gives this term's times in clear letters. Ronan reads it before he enters Miss Wu's activity.

She has three little texts for the group. One is a story. One is a notice. One is a short list of things for a picnic.

“Choose the one you want first,” she says.

Ronan chooses the picnic list. It looks easy. Five people need cups. There are three cups in one basket and two in another.

The last line says one cup is cracked.

Ronan counts four useful cups. He writes that they need one more.

Mei is beside him with the story. She reads it twice, then begins a small note.

“What did you choose?” she asks.

“The picnic.”

“I had that last time. Did you find the bad cup?”

“Yes.”

“Good. I missed it until I drew them.”

She shows him five little circles on an old practice page. One has a line through it.

Ronan laughs. “Your cup has a serious face.”

“It has a serious problem.”

Miss Wu asks each pupil to finish an answer alone first. Later they can share ways to check. She will write down any help beside the answer.

Ronan finishes the list, then chooses the story. It has two brothers and a parcel. He puts each brother's name beside the correct action. He needs help with one word and asks before he guesses.

At the end, Miss Wu gives him his practice record. It has notes from several terms. Some lines are good. Some have changes. None is a prize.

“Keep this in your folder,” she says. “We will use the record for later work.”

“What work?”

“I will explain when the plans are ready.”

Ronan takes it home. He reads the notes at the table while Mum folds the old measuring cloth.

“Did I grow?” he asks.

“Yes.”

“Enough for a new shirt?”

“Enough for the fold I opened.”

He holds out his arms. The sleeves reach his wrists again. Then he puts his practice record in the folder. There is space after the last line. Next week, he can put another answer there. He looks at the first date on the page, then closes the folder.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

sleeve＝袖子；cracked＝裂开的；record＝记录；wrist＝手腕。

## 理解问题

1. 野餐清单实际还差多少好杯子？
2. 练习记录是否就是奖项？

## 读句子

**She / has / three little texts for the group.** 她／为小组备有／三篇短文。
